similarOrganizations.description:
The Supply Chain Student Association of Kenya (SCSAK) is a national student-led organization that brings together university and college students passionate about supply chain management, procurement, and logistics. 
We aim to empower the next generation of supply chain professionals through education, networking, mentorship, and industry exposure.
Our association creates a platform for students to connect with experts, learn from real-world experiences, and participate in impactful events such as workshops, conferences, industrial visits, and community initiatives. We also collaborate with universities, professional bodies, and corporate partners to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry practice.

At SCSAK, we believe in nurturing leadership, promoting innovation, and building a strong foundation for sustainable supply chain practices across Kenya and beyond.

We welcome students, institutions, and industry partners to join us in shaping the future of supply chain in Kenya.

actor.position: Executive Humanitarian Leader | Global Health Specialist | Health Systems Strengthening | Emergency Response | Recovery & Resilience
actor.headline: Executive Humanitarian Leader | Global Health Specialist | Health Systems Strengthening | Emergency Response | Recovery & Resilience
actor.about:
I am an Executive Humanitarian and Global Health Leader with 18+ years of progressive leadership experience leading complex humanitarian and development programmes across Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia, Nigeria, and Kenya. I have dedicated my career to strengthening health systems, leading emergency response and recovery, and building resilient institutions that improve the lives of vulnerable populations.
I have led multi-million-dollar donor-funded portfolios, managed multidisciplinary teams of over 300 professionals, and provided strategic leadership for integrated programmes spanning Health, Nutrition, RMNCAH, WASH, Community Health, Food Security, Livelihoods, Protection, and Cash & Voucher Assistance (CVA). My experience includes active conflict settings, refugee operations, disease outbreaks, and protracted humanitarian crises, where strategic leadership, adaptive management, and collaboration are essential to delivering sustainable results.
Throughout my career, I have partnered with governments, UN agencies, bilateral donors, international NGOs, civil society organizations, and local communities to strengthen health systems, improve programme quality, build institutional capacity, and deliver lasting impact.
I have managed and supported programmes funded by US- DOS, UNICEF, WFP, ECHO, FCDO, BMZ, GFFO, Irish Aid, GAC, and UN OCHA-led CBPFs, leading programme strategy, proposal development, resource mobilization, grant management, donor compliance, consortium leadership, organizational performance, and strategic partnerships.
I am passionate about developing leaders, strengthening organizations, and transforming humanitarian systems through innovation, collaboration, and evidence-based leadership. I believe sustainable impact is achieved by empowering communities, strengthening local institutions, and integrating emergency response with recovery, resilience, and long-term development.
I welcome opportunities to contribute to organizations advancing humanitarian leadership, health systems strengthening, programme excellence, and sustainable development across fragile and conflict-affected settings.

Core Expertise
Executive Leadership • Country & Regional Programme Leadership • Health Systems Strengthening • Emergency Response, Recovery & Resilience • Health & Nutrition • RMNCAH • Programme Strategy & Portfolio Management • Multi-Donor Grant Management • Resource Mobilization • Consortium Leadership • Strategic Partnerships • Organizational Performance • Capacity Strengthening • Humanitarian Coordination • Adaptive Management

actor.headline: Driving Procurement Excellence |Managing Donor Compliance (USAID, World Bank,FCDO,EU) | Building Capacity & Mitigating Risk | Championing Value-for-Money & Strategic Sourcing Across Africa,Asia, Europe and Middle East.
actor.about:
As a Procurement and Logistics Specialist with over a decade of progressive experience, I thrive at the intersection of strategic sourcing, donor compliance, and supply chain optimization. My work has consistently supported high-impact, donor-funded programs (USAID, FCDO,World Bank, CDC) across East and North Africa, Asia and Europe. Currently, I serve as the Procurement Specialist at USAID-Development Alternative Inc,DAI LLC, where I lead cross-functional teams to ensure efficient procurement processes, compliant logistics systems, and value-for-money outcomes.

Throughout my career, I have:

Spearheaded procurement strategies that reduced costs and enhanced service delivery across diverse regions.

Managed grants under contract (GUC) and complex procurement lifecycles, ensuring strict compliance with donor regulations.

Built and trained high-performing procurement teams, improving capacity and aligning operations with organizational goals.

Led fleet and logistics operations, minimizing fuel and maintenance costs through innovative scheduling and planning.

Optimized ERP and eProcurement systems (SAP,TAMIS, WINPACCS, Navision, QuickBooks), strengthening procurement,accountability and reporting.

I hold a Master’s in Economics, a Diploma in Purchasing & Supplies, and am pursuing CIPS Level 4 Certification. As a Licensed Member and a registered Practitioner of the Kenya Institute of Supplies Management (KISM), I remain committed to ethical procurement, transparency, and sustainable supply chain practices.

actor.about:
Millions of people across Africa cannot access the medicines that could save their lives — not because those medicines don't exist, but because the supply chains that should deliver them are broken.
I've spent over 9 years working to fix that.
As Founder of MediBridge Africa, I'm building a digital platform that connects patients, pharmacies, and healthcare providers — making quality healthcare accessible, trackable, and accountable. As a Procurement and Supply Chain Auditor for The Global Fund, I ensure health commodities reach the people who need them most, across multiple countries.
My career spans the full supply chain spectrum — from hands-on procurement of HIV medicines and health commodities, to demand forecasting, LMIS management, logistics optimization, and now health-tech entrepreneurship. I've worked with UNFPA, The Global Fund, and national health programs, and I bring both institutional rigor and entrepreneurial agility to every engagement.
What drives me: equitable healthcare access, resilient supply systems, and technology that works for low-resource settings - JUGAAD

actor.about:
Procurement is one of the few organizational functions expected to deliver value for money, strengthen governance, support strategy, ensure compliance, and build public trust, yet many organizations still struggle with poor planning, recurring audit findings, and limited visibility into procurement performance.

My mission is to help close that gap.

I am the Founder & Chief Procurement Performance Strategist at Tijametrix™, an emerging advisory and thought leadership institution focused on improving procurement performance through evidence-based methodologies, applied research, and practical advisory.

Alongside my public service in the Judiciary of Kenya,  I am leading the development of the Procurement Performance Management System (PPMS™), an evidence-informed framework designed to help organizations measure, manage, and continuously improve procurement performance, a structured framework that integrates Procurement Planning, Procurement Assurance, and Procurement Performance Intelligence to help organizations improve governance, decision-making, and organizational performance. 

My goal is not to reinvent procurement, but to provide a more disciplined and measurable way of managing procurement performance.

With over 15 years of experience in public sector operations, procurement, supply chain management, and organizational support, I combine practical experience with analytical thinking, continuous learning, and a passion for institutional improvement.

My areas of focus include:
• Procurement Performance Management
• Public Procurement & Governance
• Procurement Planning Excellence
• Procurement Assurance & Audit Readiness
• Procurement Performance Intelligence & Analytics
• ERP & Digital Procurement
• AI for Procurement Decision Support
• Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
• Sustainable Procurement & ESG

I believe procurement should be managed as a strategic capability; not merely an administrative process. Better procurement strengthens institutions, improves service delivery, and creates lasting public value.

I welcome opportunities to connect with executives, public institutions, development partners, researchers, and professionals interested in advancing procurement performance, governance, and organizational excellence across Africa.

projects.description:
Social Buzz is a start up company in the social media and content creation industry. Its located in San Fransico with 250 employees. Due to its recent growth, its has found itself with massive amount of data with no capacity to manage and make useful insights of the data in its possession. The company therefore, sought the services of Accenture, an experienced data consultancy firm, to be able to deliver the following;

An analysis of their content categories that highlight the top 5 categories with largets aggregate popularity.
An audit of their big data practice and,
Recommendations for a successful IPO.
At Accenture, a project team was set up comprising of Andrew Fleming - The Chief Technical Architect, Marcus Rampton - Senior Principle, and myself Antony Oniala The Data Analyst. This team is working in consultation with the client's team lead by project sponsor among other stakeholders.

I will in particular work to deliver of the objective one of the project while my two colleagues focus on the other. For that reason, the rest of this project will entail the content analysis.
